scope: Reuse Apps grid delegates as they scroll into view, resetting interaction and adaptive tint state when a tile leaves the viewport.

checks.command: On the RX 9070 XT, exercise 340 Apps entries and 270 grid scroll steps with adaptive sampling disabled to isolate icon rendering. Mean render and sync time fell from 4.618 to 1.371 ms and p95 from 11.481 to 5.481 ms. Five RGBA captures across different positions matched byte for byte.

In the isolated full Apps popup with line scope, 285 entries, a fixed RGB backdrop and software OpenGL, 120 moving frames maintained 62.8 FPS. Frame time p95 improved from 19.9 to 18.4-18.8 ms versus the unpooled line candidate. The 25 settled labels retained their text, colors and geometry.
Run native Apps popup interactions for Golden Gate Light and Tahoe Dark including hover, keyboard navigation, selection and context menus: both passed.

coverage_limits: The isolated GPU render measurement and whole-popup scroll frame measurements use different render backends and fixtures. Frame rates are workload and hardware dependent.
